hints.title: Magic Constant and Center Invariant
hints.text: Every three-by-three magic square formed by integers one through nine has a fixed row, column, and diagonal sum of fifteen. Which cell value is strictly constant across all valid configurations?

hints.title: Center Digit Five Filter
hints.text: The center cell of any three-by-three magic square using numbers one through nine must be five. Any subgrid whose center is not five can be immediately skipped.

hints.title: Constant-Time Subgrid Verification
hints.text: Slide a three-by-three window across every candidate top-left coordinate. Verify that the center cell equals five, all nine values are distinct digits from one to nine, and the sums of each row, column, and diagonal equal fifteen. Increment the counter for each matching subgrid.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(R * C) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all permutations of digits for each subgrid is wasteful when direct constant-time invariant checking is available.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Checking each 3x3 window in O(1) arithmetic operations achieves O(R * C) overall runtime with strictly O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should leverage mathematical properties of 3x3 magic squares such as magic sum 15 and center cell 5.
